study_identification_part.si4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Parse individualized ALFF abnormalities in MDD using normative modeling and NMF to identify shared differential factors, relate factors to clinical features and neurobiological substrates, and replicate across multi-center datasets.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The manuscript clearly states two separate multi-center datasets were used. The discovery dataset is from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) comprising 9 research sites. The validation dataset is from the REST-meta-MDD consortium comprising 25 research sites.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium. The DIDA-MDD encompassed nine research sites... The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/REST-meta-MDD)... comprising 25 research sites

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Four shared differential factors (two positive, two negative) explain individualized ALFF abnormalities in MDD, relate to clinical features, and generalize across datasets with differing scanners, protocols, preprocessing, and medication status.
